question: An analyst has a specific quarterly business review deck outline that they need occasionally, in several different projects and sometimes in plain chats. Where does this routine best belong?
options: A) Put it into every project's instructions, so the deck outline is imposed on all of the chats in each one.
B) Keep it in a document inside one project's knowledge base and copy that file across into the other projects as needed.
C) Store it in the account-wide instructions, so the deck outline shapes every conversation the analyst has.
D) Package it as a skill, so the routine is available across projects and applies when the task calls for it.
correct_answers: D) Package it as a skill, so the routine is available across projects and applies when the task calls for it.
explanations: This forces an occasional format onto every conversation in those projects and must be maintained in each.
Copying a file around leaves several versions to maintain and does not make the routine act on demand.
An occasional deck format would then influence unrelated work in every conversation.
Correct. Skills are reusable procedures that load when relevant, rather than always-on direction tied to one workspace.
